path.advice: Make 1 now with your free transfers (+0.4 expected points over the horizon). The other 13 add -29.4 together: make them with next weeks' free transfers; each is worth a -4 hit now only if it adds more than 4.

caveat: FPL doesn't publish selling prices (you keep only half of any price rise), so your players are valued at today's price. If you'd get less for someone, lower the bank to match.
